I found no reliable 2024 evidence of such behavior. The record is therefore affirmatively anti-proliferation, but mostly through public diplomacy and civilian nuclear governance rather than through a visible case of resisting a specific proliferator. Best-supported read: yes, Hasina/Bangladesh resisted proliferation in 2024, insofar as the public record shows.
